title: Student Technology Loan Information Sheet
subtitle: Capture device serial, charger, acceptable use, and connectivity support; confirm repair route and end-of-term return.
description: Student Technology Loan records device serial, charger, acceptable use, connectivity support, repair route, and end-of-term return. Student Technology Loan evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this student technology loan controlled information handoff when staff must document device serial and charger. Reconcile acceptable use, connectivity support, repair route, and end-of-term return before the student technology loan handoff. Use the asset inventory, serial scan, charger and case count, acceptable-use agreement, connectivity request, help-desk ticket, repair estimate, and return inspection. Ask the assigned student technology loan reviewer to confirm device serial against the organization's policy.
